comments.author: yencabulator
comments.story: Patterns and problems in emerging multi-agent systems
comments.why: Offered as an example of original creative work, not a remix.
comments.text: "A lot of creative work is remixes" in no way conflicts with "That's pretty low-value creativity." Hiphop made using samples a fashion . You can think of it as choosing to restrict one's in order to explore something deeper, like a painter deciding to paint with only two pigments to exercise their skills at shading at patterning. Or you can think of it as a cheap way to make demo tracks in your bedroom. If you want to find actually creative things, look outside of mainstream, Disney, etc. I'll leave you with this link. You tell me if you think it is just a remix of something earlier: [VIDEO]

comments.author: aa-jv
comments.why: Cited as evidence techno originated with Kraftwerk in Dusseldorf.
comments.text: Techno was started in Düsseldorf by Kraftwerk. [VIDEO] People found this very inspiring and created their own variants. The Detroit variant came along. The Chicago variant came along. The UK variant came along. But it all goes back to Kraftwerk.
